datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Guatemala to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC methodology. Classification results were spatially mapped by administrative or livelihood zones and compiled into monthly geographic datasets for 2021, representing modeled/assessed food security outcomes driven by underlying hazards and livelihood disruptions.

sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to classify acute food insecurity phases across geographic units in Guatemala.
